title: Canonical system right comparison preserving the specified adjunctions
statement: Fix a prime l, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l, a finite-field datum D with l ≠ D.p, finite-type schemes X,Y over D.k, a separated finite-type relative morphism f:X→Y, a compactification c, operation and compact-support left-realization families, and a transport datum d as defined in [lem-sf-exceptional-ring-transport-core-data]. For each finite extension E/Q_l, write A_E for the integral operation and B_E for the strict-system adjunction conjugated through the two reconstruction equivalences and transported on the left by realizeF_E inverse. There is a unique family e_E:A_E.G ≅ realized(d.G_E) such that A_E.adjunction equals B_E.ofNatIsoRight(e_E inverse). It is explicitly e_E=(B_E.rightAdjointUniq A_E.adjunction) inverse. The original comparison equation holds if and only if d.realizeG_E equals this e_E. Replacing only the realizeG field by e gives a transport datum satisfying the entire family of adjunction comparison equations.

proof.text: Form B_E by the specified equivalence adjunction composites, followed by transport on the left along d.realizeF_E inverse. Both B_E and A_E.adjunction have the same left adjoint. Define e_E as the inverse of their rightAdjointUniq isomorphism. This uses only existing adjunction data and no existence choice.

The source-library theorem Adjunction.ofNatIsoRight_eq_iff says B_E.ofNatIsoRight(t) = A_E.adjunction exactly when t=B_E.rightAdjointUniq A_E.adjunction. Apply this with t=e_E inverse to prove the canonical equation, and with t=d.realizeG_E inverse to prove the necessary and sufficient condition. Taking inverse isomorphisms and function extensionality gives uniqueness of the whole family.

Update d.realizeG to the explicit family e. None of the data fields used to define B_E depends on realizeG, so the canonical equation gives the claimed equation for the updated record without any further identifications.

lean.statement: theorem existsUnique_system_adjunction_right_comparison : ∃! e : ∀ E : FieldStage.{u} l, (operation (.integral E)).G ≅ PurReconstruction.realized (d.reconstruction E false).equivalence (d.reconstruction E true).equivalence (d.G E), ∀ E : FieldStage.{u} l, (operation (.integral E)).adjunction = ((PurReconstruction.realizedAdjunction (d.reconstruction E true).equivalence (d.reconstruction E false).equivalence (d.adjunction E)).ofNatIsoLeft (d.realizeF E).symm).ofNatIsoRight (e E).symm
